name: Upcoming events + subscribe
purpose: Shows where the company will be in person next and invites visitors to join the events mailing list.
description: Hairline-bordered block on the legacy "green" theme: centred serif 4rem H2, a 3-column list (1 at 767) of upcoming-event link cards (date chip with green gradient and left rule, semibold event name, "Register today ›"), then the shared newsletter callout (heading, sub line, static email field + Subscribe button). The live CMS had a single event.
